newsitem.title: USA: Pittway Q1 alarm oper results on plan.
newsitem.headline: Pittway Q1 alarm oper results on plan.

text.p: Pittway Corp, whose first-quarter operating income rose 20 percent, said operating results for its alarm group were on plan, while those of the publishing group were slightly above expectations.

President King Harris said alarm group operating income rose 14 percent to $18 million on a 19 percent rise in sales to $252.5 million. Publishing operating income increased 48 percent to $4.9 million on an eight percent increase in sales to $48.7 million.

Pittway, a manufacturer of burglar and commercial fire alarm equipment and a publisher of trade magazines and directories, posted first-quarter net income of $12.3 million or $0.59. A year earlier, it earned $33.3 million or $1.59 per share, which included $36.6 million or $1.02 per share in special gains.
Total sales rose to $301.2 million from $257.5 million.
